name: engagement-os
description: A repeatable operating model for document-heavy consulting engagements, bid to delivery. Composable: scaffold a repo as bid-only, delivery-only, both, or a bare client-research base. Pursuit side: analyse an RFP, research the gaps, write a compliant tender response. Delivery side: ingest client materials to citable markdown, maintain a canonical fact base, write and validate findings, build deliverables through a panel review gate, keep agent memory lean. Source material is kept separate per phase so bid and delivery evidence never pool. 11 skills (eng-*) plus 6 playbook slash-commands, templates, and deterministic scripts.
